concerns.text: The plan states that `durbin_watson_test(series) → (DW, p)` will “store p‑value in FTLE result metadata”, but the `ftle_result.schema.yaml` does not define any field for a Durbin‑Watson p‑value (additionalProperties is false). This creates a schema‑validation mismatch between the plan and the data‑model/contracts.
